common.backendDown: The backend is unreachable. Try again shortly.
common.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
common.rateLimitedAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

delete.done: Deleted on both sides. The web copy is gone too.
delete.noReply: Reply to the message you want to delete with /delete.
delete.notFound: That message is not in the bridged room (it may already be deleted).
delete.forbidden: You can only delete your own messages. The web side removes its own the same way.

disconnect.done: Disconnected on both sides. The web room is closed too. Press Wired to link again any time.
disconnect.fromWeb: Disconnected from the web. This chat no longer receives web messages. Press Wired to link again.
disconnect.incomplete: Could not reach the server, so the link may still be active and web messages may keep arriving. Try Disconnect again.

help.text:
Commands:
/start: link status and quick actions
/status: full link info (account, messages, server)
/delete: reply to one of YOUR messages to delete it on both sides

Buttons:
Wired: link this chat (enter a web code)
New code: show a code to enter on the web
Disconnect: close the link on both sides

One chat links to exactly one web account. Either side can disconnect. Note: deleting a message directly in the Telegram app cannot be seen by the bot, so use /delete or delete it from the web instead.

media.backendDown: The backend is unreachable. Your message is kept, try sending it again shortly.
media.downloadFailed: Could not download that file from Telegram. Please resend it.
media.linkExpired: This link was closed on the other side. Press Wired to link again.
media.notLinked: This account is not linked yet. Press Wired first.
media.tooBigDownload: That file is over 20MB, the Bot API cannot download it.
media.tooBigForward: That file is over 50MB, it cannot be forwarded.
media.unavailable: Telegram did not return that file. Please send it again.
media.unsupported: That message type is not supported yet.

start.connected: This chat is already linked to the web. Use /status for details.
start.hello: Hi. Press Wired to link your web account, or /help for commands.

status.offlineUnwired:
Server unreachable, showing last known state: not linked.
Try /status again shortly.
status.offlineWired:
Server unreachable, showing last known state: linked.
The link may have changed on the other side. Try /status again shortly.
status.unwired:
Not linked.
Press Wired to link your web account, or /help for commands.
Server: reachable.

wired.alreadyLinked: This account is already linked to the web.
wired.askCode: Type the code from the web (example WXYZ-1234), or press New code to show a code here and enter it on the web.
wired.codeMessage:
Your code: {code}
Valid for {minutes} minutes. Enter it on the web to link.
wired.invalidFormat: Wrong code format. A valid example is WXYZ-1234.
wired.linked:
Linked to {account} on the web ✅
Everything here is forwarded both ways. /status for details.
wired.rejectedCode: The code was rejected. Get a fresh code on the web and type it again here.
wired.unknownCode: Unknown or expired code. Get a fresh code on the web and type it again here.
